delivery_role_note: Press releases, public statements, media advisories, and briefing summaries are media-facing delivery lanes. Action-changing voter guidance must point back to the current official page, signed notice, FAQ/help article, or office-help path that controls the answer.

canonical_destination_policy.plain_language_role_statement: Media-facing materials summarize and route. The linked official page, signed notice, FAQ/help article, or office instruction controls.

audience_and_accessibility_note: Use plain language, accessible HTML or accessible document publication, and captions/transcripts when live or recorded briefings carry action-changing voter instructions. Keep linked FAQ/help pages and hotline packets synchronized.
